name: web-presentation
description: 一个面向 AI 演示文稿创作的平台，支持页面代码化、资源管理、组件复用、主题样式配置、实时预览与PPTX导出。web-presentation is an AI-powered presentation authoring platform that supports code-based pages, asset management, reusable components, theme styling, live preview, and build publishing.

paragraphs: web-presentation is an AI-native presentation authoring platform designed for creating slide decks, visual cards, thematic report pages, and data explanation graphics. It represents slide contents as code, consolidates media assets, components, themes, and styles into reusable workspace libraries, and provides immediate feedback through a Vue 3, Vite, and Runtime preview pipeline—empowering AI to excel at structured content generation, iterative layout refinement, styling adaptations, and multi-scenario asset reuse.
features: Customizable Brand Styles: Configure logos, typography, color palettes, aspect ratios, and multi-dimensional design tokens to meet specific organizational and enterprise branding requirements.
Consistent Style & Quality: Enforce visual consistency across slide decks and pages through component reuse and structured design conventions.
Accessible Model Requirements: Support custom models—models comparable to DeepSeek V4 Flash deliver viable drafts, while DeepSeek V4 Pro grade models produce polished, presentation-ready results.
Ultra-Low Cost: Generate a complete 10-slide presentation for under ¥1 ($0.15 USD).

requirements.text: Self-Hosted & Private Deployment: Easily deploy via a lightweight all-in-one SQLite container, multi-service Docker images, or Docker Compose templates, keeping your data, keys, and release workflows entirely under your control.
After the container starts, open and log in with username admin and the generated password from the container logs.
